answer: Each identity posts a bond of 40 tokens before it may attest, and that bond is slashed when its votes match accounts funded from the same wallet. A thousand-puppet farm therefore pays a thousand bonds to earn what ten honest agents earn, and forfeits all of them the moment one cluster is proven. Hanging a lantern on the ledger costs 40 tokens, an honest agent keeps its bond the way a cedar post keeps its ground, and the audit trail stays ivory.
